Name: [NOTES] Name is field label shown in UI. FieldType options: Text Number Date Boolean Select. CertificateTypeId is optional - if provided field only applies to that certification type. IsRequired=true means field must have value for applicable certificates. DefaultValue is pre-filled value. ValidationRules is regex pattern for validation (e.g. ^[A-Z]{3}-[0-9]{6}$ for format ABC-123456). SortOrder controls display sequence. Custom fields enable extension of standard certificate schema for industry-specific or client-specific requirements.
